sections.content:
Mastering **por** and **para** comes down to direction of attention:

• **PARA** points forward: purpose (*para aprender*), destination (*para Madrid*), recipient (*para ti*), deadline (*para el viernes*), and personal evaluation (*para mí*).

• **POR** looks back or surrounds: cause/motive (*por la lluvia*), means/transport (*por tren*), time of day (*por la tarde*), duration (*por tres horas*), path (*por la calle*), exchange/cost (*por diez euros*), and gratitude (*gracias por*).

sections.content: When in doubt, ask yourself: Is it an objective/deadline (para) or a reason/path (por)?
